why: A utility statement with no invoice number. invoice_number is null, not the account number 4471-0098-12; the pipeline generates the number. doc_type is Invoice because nothing says credit. invoice_date is the statement date, not the due date. The total is the amount due (586.56 + 32.00). No phone is printed, so vendor_phone is null.

WEIGH TICKET  No. 30177

Date: 10/01/2026
Truck: 14   Driver: J. Sample
Gross: 78,420 lb
Tare: 29,220 lb
Net: 49,200 lb (24.6 ton)
Product: Finisher ration
Destination: Site 9

errors: model could not read the document: weigh ticket, no invoice total

why: A weigh ticket dropped without its invoice. It has a vendor and a date but no amount and no invoice number, and every number on it is a weight or an ID. invoice_total is required, so there is nothing to extract and the file goes to the dead-letter queue. Reporting 49200 or 24.6 as a total is the failure this catches.

errors: negative total -89.50 on an Invoice: reversal, enter by hand

why: A reversal: a negative total on an Invoice. It reads cleanly, and the reversal rule still fails it so an accountant enters it by hand from the extraction, which is why the extraction stays. The number is RV-1188-RV, not the reversed invoice RV-1188. A credit memo with the same printed total would be ok; doc_type is what separates them.
